name: ai-fill-long-gap
description: A gap over the model's limit (45 frames) is filled in one undo step: anchor poses from the library split it into spans the model takes. A standing key on 0 and, on 90, the built-in walk's pose from its frame 8 (keys.copy from Locomotion/Walk, pasted on 90, then its root set 2 m ahead: y = -2 / 0.8698308 = -2.2993044 hip heights, the walk's own height 0.9027198). ai.gaps says the 89-frame gap is fillable with 2 anchors. The anchor frames are worked by hand: the fewest evenly spaced frames keeping every span at or under 30 frames key to key, ceil(90 / 30) = 3 spans, so 30 and 60. The anchor poses come from the one library segment whose start pose is nearest the stand and whose end pose, speed x 90 frames later, is nearest the walk pose (speeds 0.5..2): the Walk loop itself, from its frame 5 to 140 at 1.5x (140 - 5 = 135 = 1.5 x 90), so the anchors are its frames 5 + 1.5 x 30 = 50 and 5 + 1.5 x 60 = 95 (the loop wraps: 50 is 17, 95 is 29 of its 33 frames), tagged "anchor Locomotion/Walk @50" and "@95" on the timeline between three bands of the model's keys. The same anchors come back after an undo and a second fill, and the left foot stands on the same spot on frame 45 (pinned: the network's output, checked for determinism; the motion is reviewed in the MP4). The diagnostics cover the whole span: seams at both keys and at each anchor, all under the 1 m/s and 3 rad/s lines (pinned: 0.5748 m/s at 30, 0.3198 at 60; no pop or spin flag), no joint bent back; the planted feet slide under the 2 cm line over a contact with physics off (pinned; before Document::hold_contacts held the point each foot stands on, this fill slid 11.5 cm; a normal 30-frame fill of the same stand-to-walk slides 2.6 cm and the mocap walks' own keys 4-8 cm, tests/quality/builtins.json; crates/ac-cli/tests/long_fill_feet.rs checks the line itself). Undo reads "AI fill 1–89" and takes the anchors away with the fill. A long gap with anchors "none" is refused, as is an unknown anchors choice. Physics is off: this checks the keys. Tolerance 1e-3: planting solves the legs with IK, which moves the foot points by rounding only.
